text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're at UMASK, a store inside the train station, and one of the headlines on the newspapers out front catches our attention.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look at this! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's the popularity poll for the Takarazuka Kinen! I'm in the top three!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And just one spot below McQueen. I can't believe it, I made the top three.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is definitely a mistake… isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A celebrity? Me? But… I don't feel like one in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, look. Isn't that Mejiro Ryan over there?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ryan doesn't ride the train, does she? But now that you mention it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Panicked, we hurry onto the train. There, we think about how things are slowly beginning to change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I thought I got into the Arima Kinen last year because of McQueen's popularity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But to be in the top three…
choice_data_list: That's because of your great showing at the Tenno Sho.
That's because of your great showing at the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh… If that's true, then it means my popularity is linked to my race results, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So if I try even harder, then my popularity should grow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You know… That makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There are people out there following what I'm doing! A lot of them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Effort leads to skill, and skill leads to popularity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The clouds part and a ray of light shines through. Whatever Mejiro Ryan wants… she just might get.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I think I have to give it up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I mean, I have to stop pretending to give up, stop lying to myself. And…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I need to stop acting ashamed of my childish dream, like some snob.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I really want to become a star Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanna be able to accept people's support, to respond to them with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So in a race where everyone's selected by the fans, I definitely wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanna win 'em both—this year's Takarazuka Kinen and Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning both of the big Grand Prix races in the same year… If she can do that, she'll be a superstar without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's a high bar to set…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Can I really take on this challenge? No, it's not just a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's my dream, and I'll give 100% to make it come true! I want us to achieve it together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've finally got a huge dream, one that doesn't fall short compared to McQueen's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make it come true with you by my side!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, have you seen the news?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This year's Takarazuka Kinen will be held at Kyoto Racecourse—the same as the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shows me the article, and it's true. It seems to be due to the renovations going on at Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I get to race McQueen there, one more time…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see. That's why she said the next time we'd meet would be in a medium-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She already knew that I'd be picked for the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That also means McQueen is going to be in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next battlefield has been decided. It's time for Ryan to face her rival on a medium-distance course, where she'll have the upper hand.
